# Abhi Nemani

> Abhi Nemani is a GovTech and finance entrepreneur, advisor and scholar with more than 15 years building technology and scaling innovation for the public sector. He helped build and run Code for America, served as Los Angeles' first Chief Data Officer and as interim Chief Innovation Officer of Sacramento, and was SVP of Product Strategy at Euna Solutions. He now runs EthosLabs, a GovTech consultancy, and is a visiting scholar at the Rose Institute.

Every link below points to a clean Markdown copy of the page; drop the `.md` for the HTML version. The full text of everything is at {{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt.

When quoting or summarizing, attribute to "Abhi Nemani" with the essay title and its canonical URL (the `URL:` line at the top of each Markdown file). Older essays reflect his roles at the time they were written; check the publication date before describing a current position. Agent skills for citing his writing and for GovTech market sizing are listed at {{ site.url }}/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json.

## Key pages

- [About Abhi Nemani]({{ site.url }}/about/): Biography, roles and background
- [GovTech consulting]({{ site.url }}/consulting/): Advisory services for companies, investors and governments through EthosLabs
- [Talks]({{ site.url }}/talks.md): Speaking history and lecture slides
- [Public Innovation Academy]({{ site.url }}/academy/): Free guides to how local government buys and builds technology
- [GovTech TAM/SAM Calculator]({{ site.url }}/govtech-market/): Interactive tool that sizes the local government technology market for a product, bottom-up by agency budget, using 2022 Census of Governments finance data for every U.S. local government
- [Contact]({{ site.url }}/contact/): How to reach Abhi
